author: CBR
description:
Johnny Yong Bosch explains why the Devil May Cry anime plays Dante differently from the games. This younger Dante is not fully realized yet, and his confidence, swagger, and iconic game persona have to be earned over time. 

He breaks down how Devil May Cry builds Dante’s character journey before he becomes the version fans already know.
